title: SpaceX reaches orbit with Falcon 1 - Flight 4 (full video including Elon Musk statement)
summary: The full webcast of SpaceX's Falcon 1 Flight 4, the first privately developed liquid-fueled rocket to reach orbit, on 28 September 2008. It includes the crew's cheering and Elon Musk's statement afterward.
why: HN shares it as a nostalgic, historic moment, noting the cheers at each milestone and Musk's address to employees.

quote.text: The series of cheers at each milestone, as the article mentions, is pretty awesome.
